rows.en: (I have to say, that was a surprise...)

(I never thought Pinon-chan would be the one
to ask me to walk home together...)

Hey, \p...
I wasn't a nuisance, was I?
Huh? What do you mean?
W-well, I mean, me inviting you...
A nuisance? No way, not at all.
R-really?

Of course, really.
I'd be happy if you invited me again.

...Okay, got it!
I'll invite you next time too,
so don't you dare say no!
As you wish, Pinon-chan.

(I'll look forward to Pinon-chan
inviting me out like this again.)
(I have to say, that was a surprise...)

Of course, really.
I'd be happy if you invited me again.
(I promised to go shopping with Ranka today.)

(She said something like, 'I want to ask
your advice about some shopping...'
I wonder what it's about...)
Ranka's late...

\p-kun,
sorry to keep you waiting!

Sorry I'm late.
I kind of got lost on the way...

Nah, it's fine.
More importantly, what's this 'advice
about shopping' thing?

Um...
I want to buy some everyday things for Big Bro...
rows.notes: Ranka, both genders. oniichan = Big Bro as c02894.

rows.en:
Everyday things, you mean...
...like a toothbrush?

Exactly!
I wanted a guy's opinion on things like
what kind you normally use, so...

I see.
Well then, let's get going.

Come to think of it, Ranka, your big brother
is that overprotective...
...Ozma-san, right?

Ahahaha.
Yes, 'that' brother of mine...

Ozma-san's a former pilot, right...?
Then maybe he'd like something manly?

Well, here's the thing...
Big Bro is surprisingly fussy at home.
Huh?! I didn't know that...

He nitpicks every little thing I do...
Don't you think that's awful?

Doesn't that just show how much
he cares about you, Ranka?
He's WAY too overprotective!

You two get along so well, though.
I'm kind of jealous...
But we're always fighting, you know?

Now, now, they do say the more
you fight, the closer you are.
Mmmph~...
Hahaha, well, let's just do our shopping for now.
Thank you so much for today!
Was my opinion actually any help?

Yes, it was a huge help!
I'm sure Big Bro will be happy too!
Glad to hear it. Say hi to Ozma-san for me.
Okay. Well then, I should be heading home now.
Okay, see you, then.
(Ranka really loves her big brother, huh.)
(I promised to go shopping with Ranka-chan today.)

(She said something like, 'I want to ask
your advice about some shopping...'
I wonder what it's about...)
Ranka-chan's late...

\p-chan,
sorry to keep you waiting!

Don't worry about it at all.
So what are we going shopping for today?
Yes, exactly!!

Come to think of it, Ranka-chan, your big brother
is that overprotective...

Ozma-san's a former pilot, right...?
Then maybe he'd like something manly?
Huh?! Really?

Doesn't that just show how much
he cares about you, Ranka-chan?

Well, they do say the more
you fight, the closer you are.
Ahaha, well, let's just do our shopping for now.
Was my opinion actually any help?
(Ranka-chan really loves her big brother, huh.)
\p-kun, sorry to keep you waiting.
rows.notes: Ranka, male (second visit); also Akimizu in frd_yuu_003/008.

rows.en: Okay, let's get going, then.

Thank you again today!
You even carried my bags for me...
That's no trouble at all.

Come by Nyan-Nyan sometime.
I'll make it up to you for today.

You really don't have to worry about it.
But I'll definitely come eat there.

Well then, I'll head home for today.
See you next time!
(Ranka sure is full of energy.)
\p-chan, sorry to keep you waiting.
rows.notes: Ranka, female; also Akimizu in frd_yuu_003/008.

rows.en: Yeah, let's get going.
That's no trouble at all.
(Ranka-chan sure is full of energy.)

uncertain: c12625/c12650: the player calls Ozma a 'former pilot' (moto pairotto) as the Japanese says, though he is an active S.M.S. pilot in the series; translated literally.
